roughness_rms.name: Rugosidad sin inclinación
roughness_rms.description: RMS del residuo de elevación tras ajustar un plano en cada vecindario cuadrado. Un plano inclinado tiene rugosidad cero.

topographic_position.name: Posición topográfica
topographic_position.description: Elevación de la celda menos la media del vecindario: positiva en posiciones altas y negativa en bajas.

laplacian.name: Curvatura discreta
laplacian.description: Laplaciano de elevación con cuatro vecinos; positivo en formas cóncavas y negativo en convexas. No es curvatura geométrica normalizada.

sources.name: DTM HiRISE y SRTM locales
sources.processing: Specify formula, physical neighbourhood, cell size, valid-neighbour support and uncertainty. Not implemented.
limitations: Derived features share source information with existing slope and relief.
No rock scale mobility inference.

sources.name: USGS 3DEP Utah, 1 m
sources.coverage: Phase-1 rectangle inspection covers Utah initial window; pixel validity not verified.
sources.processing: Inspect full raster, vertical datum, masks and sensitivity before comparing with HiRISE.
limitations: Bare-earth DEM is not a complete surface obstacle model.

sources.name: HiRISE ortoimagen RED_A de Jezero
sources.coverage: Declared extent covers the phase-2 area; full image and valid mask not acquired.
sources.processing: Preserve label, masks and illumination metadata; manual labels before automated object measurements.
limitations: Image sampling does not increase DTM resolution.
Require multiple pixels per detectable object.

sources.name: NAIP ortofotografia
sources.authentication: Use provider route; public downloads available
sources.coverage: Utah/Mojave products must be selected; no Atacama coverage.
sources.processing: Select campaign/tile, evaluate shadows, season and masks; aggregate to comparable physical support.
limitations: Cannot detect all decimetric rocks.
Campaign resolution and positional accuracy vary.

sources.name: MRO CRISM, MTRDR or targeted calibrated products
sources.format: PDS binary, label, geometry and numerical parameters as selected
sources.coverage: Jezero observations documented in primary research; exact phase-2 polygon overlap and valid pixels pending.
sources.processing: Prefer an appropriate derived projected product if available; validate atmospheric/photometric treatment and numerical parameters.
limitations: Observation ID is not a fully selected downloadable product.
Band depth is not automatically mineral abundance.
Do not equate class codes or uncorrected reflectance with EMIT.

sources.name: EMIT L2B Mineral Identification V002
sources.authentication: NASA Earthdata Login for protected files; CMR metadata public
sources.processing: Use GLT/geolocation; apply masks, fit quality and uncertainty. Crosswalk only supported mineral categories with CRISM.
limitations: Point search is not full AOI valid-pixel coverage.
Spatially raw, non-orthocorrected delivery.
Not a complete soil mechanics measurement.
Keep V001/V002 separate.

sources.name: EMIT L2A Reflectance
sources.coverage: Select co-temporal compatible granules after L2B quality review.
sources.processing: Geolocate and mask spectra, account for instrument bandpass and measurement conditions before comparing spectral descriptors.

sources.name: USGS mapa geologico de Jezero SIM 3464
sources.authentication: Public publication; direct object returned 403 in this investigation
sources.format: ZIP GIS database; internal layers not inspected
sources.processing: Read legend, map scale, CRS and interpreted unit polygons; validate spatial overlap and derive area fractions.
limitations: Download is listed but byte access not verified.
Geologic units are interpretations, not pixel chemical measurements.

sources.name: Utah Geological Survey cartografia
sources.format: GIS package or GeoJSON export depending on selected map
sources.processing: Select map covering full Utah polygon, inspect legend, scale and provenance; create reviewed cross-body material grouping.
limitations: Portal does not itself establish the best map for this window.

sources.name: SERNAGEOMIN cartografia de Atacama
sources.format: Publication-dependent; GIS availability not confirmed for selected area
sources.processing: Select sheet and digital layers covering phase-2 Atacama polygon; preserve legend and verify reuse conditions.

sources.name: THEMIS-derived Thermal Inertia of Jezero Crater
sources.processing: Review cross-product Mars coordinate conventions and independent coregistration before analytical overlay.
limitations: Thermal inertia is not temperature.
AOI QA assumes shared longitude/latitude interpreted on product sphere.
No Earth thermal-inertia counterpart selected.
Not integrated into the existing atlas.

sources.name: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature
sources.authentication: USGS account for EarthExplorer; route-specific access elsewhere
sources.units: Kelvin after published scale and offset
sources.processing: Select L2SP scene with valid surface temperature; mask clouds and invalid/uncertain pixels; preserve acquisition time.
limitations: Surface temperature cannot be compared numerically with thermal inertia.
30 m output is resampled thermal information.

sources.name: Sentinel-2 L2A
sources.authentication: Copernicus Data Space account for selected download route
sources.format: SAFE/JP2 and metadata; select required bands
sources.processing: Choose cloud-free observations and relevant bands, inspect quality and actual tile overlap.
limitations: Not suitable for small rock counting.
Multispectral indices do not provide CRISM-equivalent mineral identification.

sources.name: TES Dust Cover Index ASU visualization
sources.processing: Context only; locate original quantitative product and compatible method before numerical use.
limitations: Coarser than 1.8 km analysis window.
Surface dust index is not atmospheric aerosol optical depth.
Do not decode a visualization as scientific values.

sources.name: JRC Global Surface Water
sources.format: Raster tiles; freeze layer and version
sources.processing: Select occurrence/history product, record release, account for collection alignment and valid observation counts.
limitations: Current/historical Earth surface water is not a direct analogue measurement of ancient Mars water.
2026 update combines collections with documented alignment limitations.

sources.name: SWIM4MIM ice consistency
sources.processing: Define an ice-resource scenario and regional AOI; select consistency and support layers.
limitations: Consistency index is not a calibrated probability or per-pixel ice detection.
Too coarse to resolve the current local window.
No Earth subsurface ice counterpart selected.
Descriptores exploratorios de terreno; no certifican analogía, movilidad ni seguridad.
Rugosidad, posición y curvatura comparten los mismos DEM con pendiente y relieve; no son evidencias independientes.
El paso de celda no iguala la resolución efectiva, los errores de sensor ni la referencia vertical de los productos.
El vecindario se extiende fuera de la ventana analizada. Su radio se mantiene en metros al cambiar de celda.
La curvatura discreta es sensible al ruido y al tamaño de celda; no se combina con las otras variables en una puntuación.
Inercia térmica solo observada para Jezero. Temperatura terrestre no sustituye a inercia térmica.
La cobertura mide soporte numérico; no exactitud física ni observaciones independientes.
